description: This PHP source file defines the Milestone class within the Goteo project. It includes properties and methods for retrieving, listing, validating, saving, and selecting random milestones from a database, supporting features like localization and image handling.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: A model class representing project milestones, with methods for data retrieval, validation, persistence, and random selection, supporting localization and image management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a milestone record by ID, with optional language parameter, and fetches associated images if available.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all milestones, with localization considerations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the milestone data, primarily ensuring the description is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists the milestone data, handling image uploads and database insert/update operations.

methods.name: random_milestone
methods.description: Selects a random milestone matching specified criteria, raising an exception if none are found.
